items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is day-to-day with a rib injury suffered in Week 1; HC Jim Harbaugh says they will monitor how he feels this week before deciding Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Big hit midsection; Harbaugh day-to-day; RapSheet confirms status up in air.
items.implication: Monitor practice; prepare backup for Week 2.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for Quentin Johnston, Tre Harris if out.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers suffered a hamstring injury that is not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned in a playoff game; MRI pending but coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Aggravation but sources say not serious; coach Jesse Minter confirms DTD good sign.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 but monitor; soft tissue risk.
items.opportunity: If out, Bateman and others elevate; Lane already out wrist.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY; affects Etienne projections. Love/Odunze expected; Nabers pending (later active).
items.opportunity: Etienne primary but split per Levitan data.

items.text: Kenneth Walker ran for 173 yards in Chiefs debut — most for any KC player since Mahomes became starter. Berry/Rap praise full grown man/miracle.
items.why: Explosive debut post-signing; volume and efficiency.
items.implication: Immediate RB1/2 in KC backfield; hold/start confidently.

items.text: Lions offense incredibly concentrated: Gibbs, Amon-Ra St. Brown, LaPorta, Jameson Williams accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, WR3, or TE2 usage.
items.why: Post-Week 1 data; as expected concentration on elite core.
items.implication: Start the four with extreme confidence; ignore others in DET.
items.opportunity: Massive snap/target/carry share locked in for core.

items.text: Bucky Irving usage solid if overstated by 22.3 PPR: 8 carries (only RB carry inside 10), 21 routes (out-routed Gainwell 21-13), 7 targets all caught; looked extremely healthy. Great matchup vs CLE next.
items.why: GL work, route win, healthy post-injury concerns.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with upside; prefer over Gainwell.

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays; buying low everywhere possible as Bears offense piece.
items.why: Elite route share despite quiet stats; preseason belief in CHI offense intact.
items.implication: Buy-low TE with weekly upside; hold/start flex.
items.opportunity: High route % signals target growth coming.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak considers TE Brock Bowers day-to-day after last week's meniscus trim; optimistic progress, possible Week 2 return vs Chargers.
items.why: Meniscus cleanup; HC day-to-day and working hard.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer benefitted Week 1 but Bowers elite when back.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated snaps/targets if limited/out.

items.text: With Kamara (knee) out, Etienne didn't dominate: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4. Committee persists.
items.why: Even without Kamara, split with Miller/Donaldson.
items.implication: Etienne not automatic RB1; monitor if Kamara returns.
items.opportunity: Miller/Donaldson handcuff value if Etienne limited.

items.text: Malik Nabers active for Week 1 after late decision (family didn't travel due to uncertainty); played ~2 hours before kickoff decision post-ACL/meniscus.
items.why: Late call; emerged healthy with solid usage per Levitan.
items.implication: Cleared and productive return; full go ROS optimism.
items.opportunity: 71% routes, 31% target share in limited snaps.

items.text: Ravens WR Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) among key injuries watched; fractured wrist leads to multi-game absence.
items.why: Fractured wrist per reports; longer term.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth thinned with Flowers DTD.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but wouldn't activate if injury worry; starting him everywhere owned. ETR had expected to play.
items.why: Active designation + Cardinals context; ETR expected.
items.implication: Start with upside in favorable spots.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks; even after Dylan Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.implication: Limited upside in pass-heavy or committee; wait for more.
items.opportunity: Sanders or others if Judkins not earning routes.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets 31% share, 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: Strong route/target share on limited snaps.
